expected.outcome: A deterministic pure Kotlin/JVM 7x7 board core implementing the accepted v0.2 board rules, with immutable state, deterministic RNG/replay, connected-group Tap/Pop, tile behaviors, wall/overflow/seal and stable state digest.
expected.evidence: Exact-candidate Gradle/JUnit, pure-JVM boundary, Maestro GateRunner and EFB-001 ADR validation pass.

actual.outcome: Candidate implements the scoped deterministic board core and includes the Product Owner pre-review corrections for half-Ink precision and independent golden hue-weight expectations.
corrections: Half-Ink remains exact in integer half-units through Spectrum multiplication; final payout rounds once, half-up.
Hue-weight tests use independent golden expected values rather than deriving expected output from the implementation.

lessons: Preserve fractional resource payouts until every multiplier has been applied; round once at the boundary.
Golden tests must use independent expected values and must not mirror implementation logic.
Bind every verification claim to the exact candidate SHA and preserve the distinction between Product Owner acceptance and independent review.

disposition.acceptance_basis: The Product Owner explicitly stated the prior feedback required only one review, confirmed the result is acceptable, and directed that EFB-002 be marked complete.
disposition.formal_github_approve_review: Not submitted; GitHub prevents the PR author from approving their own pull request.
disposition.limitations: This is not represented as an independent Mastery review. EFB-000 merged-tree review and rights disposition remain separate prerequisites; no legacy code/assets are cleared for reuse.

next_increment: EFB-003 turn/combat state machine, after EFB-000 review/rights disposition and Maestro durable workflow continuity/reviewer dispatch are complete.
